description: Make a lip-synced talking video from one photo: the face speaks your text in a built-in voice (text + voice_id) or your audio (audio_url). Returns a job id at once; rendering takes ~1-3 min, then call stork_talking_photo_status. Paid from Stork credits (standard 20 credits = $0.20 per minute at 720p), or tier 'free' for a watermarked video up to 30 s (small daily allowance). Needs 'Authorization: Bearer sk_stork_<key>'. Only animate faces you have permission to use.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of speech audio (instead of text)

image_url.description: Public https URL of a photo with one clear face

text.description: What the face says (use with voice_id)

name: stork_talking_photo_create
